Morning stiffness lasts 1-3 hours; pain is typically mild (2-3/10) but functionally limiting. She reports significant fatigue, nonrestorative sleep, and mood changes (low mood/anxiety) following the death of her long-term partner about a year ago. No joint swelling, redness, neurologic symptoms, or known autoimmune history. Past history notable for severe sulfonamide antibiotic reaction consistent with Stevens-Johnson syndrome. No other chronic medical conditions reported.
